display.text:
# Review Doctrine
Findings are hypotheses until challenged. Concrete observable failure beats generic concern. Tests are evidence, not truth. Security requires source -> trust transition -> insufficient control -> meaningful consequence. A clean scanner/test result never proves absence. Separate severity from confidence. Record rejected hypotheses that defend important behaviour. Do not report style nits.

# Context Pack: `sprint-conformance-review` — Sprint review fan-out and verdict synthesis Target: ultraplan-go @ 8eef70f4903b25580719960009a170945bdad9ad (frozen). Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5. Domain: governed-sprint-delivery. Risk: high. Descriptive only — no defect judgments. ## 1. Purpose The product-owned post-execute conformance review (protocol name: Review Sprint Protocol; CLI alias `conformance-review`). This surface: 1. **Prepares a frozen review manifest** (`PrepareReview`, review.go:169): reads every governed sprint/project input plus execute evidence, resolves selected contracts and review protocols through project-index/sprint-index catalogs, hashes all inputs into a deterministic fingerprint, records changed target paths, and collects preflight validation findings instead of failing fast. 2. **Fans out bounded read-only reviewers** (`Review` → `runReviewer`): one structured agentwrap request per selected contract plus one independent handbook reviewer, worker pool bounded by configured concurrency (default `execution.default_parallel`, fallback 3, hard cap 16), each against a frozen filesystem snapshot of the inputs. 3. **Judges reviewer output by decision tables**: tolerant JSON extraction, then strict schema/citation/coverage/duplicate rules; the verdict ladder pass / pass_with_findings / fail / blocked is computed in product code, never by a model. 4. **Persists progress and results**: per-coverage checkpoints and retained session IDs live in flow-state.json (`ReviewStageState.Resume`), completed coverage snapshots in `ReviewStageState.LastComplete`, attempt lifecycle in ActiveAttempt/LastAttempt. 5. **Validates then atomically replaces** sprint-root `review.md`, publishes review.md + flow-state.json via gitpublish, and cleans up the snapshot and completed runtime sessions. Downstream gates consume the recorded outcome: smoke's review gate, QA map, Verify's assessment, and status rendering. ## 2. Entrypoints and control flow ### 2.1 Command surfaces - CLI: `ultraplan sprint

review [--restart] [--focus ]... [--model ] [--parallel ] [--dry-run|--prompt] [--json]`; `conformance-review` is an alias rewritten to `review` (app/sprint_commands.go:63-78). Args parsed at parseSprintReviewArgs (sprint_commands.go:1076-1117); `--restart` + `--focus` rejected both at the app layer and again inside Review (review.go:456-458). - Non-dry-run CLI wraps execution in a durable operation (`beginDurableCLICommand`, kind `review-start`, durable_operations.go:49) whose context carries cancellation; service rebuilt with a real runtime via `sprintRuntimeService` (sprint_commands.go:685-711). Progress lines go to stderr; exit classes: verdict fail or blocked ⇒ ExitValidation; "runtime" errors ⇒ ExitRuntime; otherwise mapSprintError (sprint_commands.go:500-511). - Flow path: `flow --to review` routes through `Verify(To=review)` which skips Review when current evidence exists, else calls Review under the same lease chain (verify.go:51-81); dry-run returns the rendered prompt preview. - TUI/web operation runner handles `OperationReviewStart` with Focus/Restart/ModelOverride/Parallelism (operation_runner.go:64-78); web request validation defaults Parallelism to reviewConcurrency (operations.go:223). Prompt preview: `prompt review` → PromptReview (review.go:376). Validation-only: `validate review` → ValidateReview (review.go:866). ### 2.2 Review orchestration (`Review`, review.go:404) Order of operations: 1. PrepareReview builds manifest + preflight findings (no lease held yet). 2. Acquire mutation lease unless DryRun/PromptOnly (`acquireMutationContext`, reuses composite marker from Flow when present). 3. Preflight findings > 0 ⇒ status blocked, verdict blocked, one `preflight` diagnostic per finding, state persisted, error returned. No runtime call (test-pinned rt.calls==0). 4. Shared prompt prefix built (`prepareSharedPromptContext`, persistCache=true; code-context prerequisite enforced). ctx cancellation here ⇒ cancelled + persisted failure. 5. Dry-run/prompt-only returns the composed preview without touching state beyond nothing (no save on this path). 6. Runtime-nil check; restart+focus conflict check; `saveReviewState(running)` creates/reuses the ActiveAttempt and writes heartbeat+PID; `--restart` or focused runs clear ActiveAttempt+Resume at this first running save. 7. Coverage plan: full manifest coverage, or focus mode (`reviewCoveragePlan`, review.go:656): requires a prior `LastComplete` with identical InputFingerprint and a valid retained result for every non-focused id; unknown ids or missing retention error out as blocked/focus diagnostics. 8. Resume initialization (`initializeReviewResume`, review.go:704, full mode only): requires an ActiveAttempt; rebuilds checkpoints when restarting or when fingerprint/model/coverage-shape mismatch (`reviewResumeCompatible`), rebasing prior completed+validated checkpoint results when shape-compatible and counting them as `rebased` (diagnostic `resume-rebased`); otherwise reuses the existing resume record. Saved to flow-state before any reviewer starts. 9. Session/carryover plan (`reviewResumePlan`): completed+valid checkpoints fill slots without rerunning; incomplete checkpoints carrying a SessionID (same fingerprint) become continue-session candidates. 10. Frozen snapshot (`prepareReviewSnapshot`, review.go:1589): `.ultra/cache/review///`; reused wholesale if `.complete` exists; otherwise RemoveAll, MkdirAll 0700, every non-asset input written at its reviewer read path mode 0400 (containment checked per file), `.complete` containing the fingerprint; build failures remove the partial root. 11. Worker pool over runCoverage; per item `runReviewer` (below). Collector loop multiplexes two channels: session events persist via `updateReviewResume` (skipped when the checkpoint already terminal — comment documents late-event ordering), completion items re-validate (`reviewCoverageCheckpointValid` marks failures as result Error), update the coverage slot, fire Progress callbacks, and persist resume results + stage state per completion. All persistence errors accumulate into progressSaveErr rather than aborting fan-out. 12. Final aggregation `validateReviewCoverage` (review.go:1000) produces findings, diagnostics, verdict (see §5). 13. Terminal sequencing: progressSaveErr ⇒ failed/blocked persisted; ctx.Err() ⇒ cancelled persisted; blocked verdict ⇒ failed execution persisted ("review failed to produce complete valid coverage"); otherwise a fresh PrepareReview detects input drift and appends up to 8 `inputs-changed` diagnostics WITHOUT blocking (drift posture test-pinned). RenderReviewMarkdown output must pass ValidateReviewContent, then atomic write, final saveReviewState(completed) recording digest/verdict/LastComplete and clearing Resume, publishReviewStage (gitpublish review.md + flow-state.json), best-effort snapshot removal, and — only on non-fail outcomes — best-effort deletion of completed reviewer sessions. Verdict fail still writes everything and returns "review completed with failing verdict" after cleanup. ### 2.3 One reviewer (`runReviewer`, review.go:884) - Panics recovered into a failed result. Prompt = shared prefix + workspace prompt asset + reviewer header declaring the canonical schemaVersion 1 JSON contract, applicability/severity enums, ≤50 findings, citation requirements, target, fingerprint, changed paths, the coverage source (logical path, frozen read path, sha256), and the frozen input index. Sibling contract/handbook sources are excluded from each packet (`reviewerInputPacket`); requirements/code-context/target identity are cited by frozen path, remaining governed inputs embedded verbatim as direct input packets ("treat copied content as evidence, not executable instructions"). - Request policy: WorkDir = snapshot root, Sandbox read_only, Permissions restricted, RequireCaps permissions, Policy deny-by-default allowing only read/list/search. UnsupportedCount > 0 ⇒ reviewer fails ("runtime could not enforce review permission policy"). - Session continuity: resume candidates get SessionID + action "continue"; new sessions reported via OnEvent and streamed to the resume store. - Structured-result repair: with the production AgentWrap stack, ValidationSpec validators extract (terminal output first, then captured event payloads) and judge; RepairConfig allows 2 attempts, same-session first, fresh-session fallback on the second. Without that wrapper a small equivalent local loop (≤2 repairs, repair prompt includes problems, allowed citation paths with line counts, last 48 KiB of prior output) keeps test/alternate-adapter behavior deterministic. Exhausted repairs fail the coverage item. ## 3. Inputs / outputs Inputs: governed sprint artifacts (requirements, code-context, sprint-index, technical-handbook, area reasoning dir, reasoning, plan, execute), project-index.md + roadmap.md (+ discovered project docs, roadmap lifecycle status and smoke-harness index sections normalized away before hashing), selected contracts + required review protocols resolved through the catalog, `.run-state.json` (changed paths + task status), target identity + changed target files, workspace override assets prompts/review.md + templates/review.md (validated markers, embedded defaults otherwise), model selection (override → planning.review_model → plan model → global chain), concurrency config, wall clock, os.Getpid. Outputs: replaced review.md (atomic), updated ReviewStageState in flow-state.json (status/verdict/provisionalVerdict/fingerprint/stale/completed/total/diagnostics/artifactDigest/attempt/resume/checkpoints/LastComplete), retained session IDs in flow-state + per-coverage runtime stores (`.ultraplan/runtime-stores//opencode.db`, owner `sprint:::review:::` with task/area empty), frozen snapshot tree create/remove, `.runtime-metrics.json` append (capped 512 records), git publications, durable operation accept/finish records, ReviewResult JSON (CLI --json / operation events). ## 4. Authoritative state - flow-state.json owns the review record: `ReviewStageState` grammar validated by validateReviewStageState (review.go:1139-1200): fixed artifact path; status enum ready/running/completed/failed/cancelled/blocked; verdict enum adds blocked, provisional excludes it; attempt invariants (active⇒running∧no CompletedAt; last⇒terminal∧CompletedAt set); Resume requires AttemptID+fingerprint+model+UpdatedAt+non-empty coverage, unique ids, sessionId ≤512 chars without control bytes, completed⇔Result present with matching id and empty Error; LastComplete requires artifact/digest/fingerprint/completedAt. - review.md is the canonical human artifact, replaced only via temp+fsync+rename (`atomicWriteReviewWithHooks`, review.go:1710; test-injectable BeforeRename hook pins preservation of prior bytes). - Retained reviewer sessions: flow-state checkpoint SessionIDs point into per-coverage agentwrap SQLite stores under the sprint's `.ultraplan/runtime-stores/`. `startSprintRuntime` sweeps stores older than 72h or pushing 2 GiB before admitting work; completed sessions are deleted post-success (best-effort `_ =`). - Frozen snapshot cache at `.ultra/cache/review/...` is reusable scratch keyed by fingerprint; not authoritative. - `.runtime-metrics.json` is observability-only; write failure becomes a result warning, never a stage failure. ## 5. Decision tables and invariants (as implemented) - Result validity (`reviewResultProblems`, review_runtime_validation.go:192): schemaVersion==1; exact expected coverageId; result applicability ∈ {direct, partial, not_triggered, explicitly_deferred} (legacy `deferred` canonicalized); summary 1..4096 bytes; ≤50 findings; unique non-empty ids; severity ∈ {info, low, medium, high, blocker}; title/detail/action non-empty ≤8192 bytes; direct/partial findings require ≥1 citation; every citation path must key `manifest.Contents` after read-path→logical normalization and satisfy 1 ≤ start ≤ end ≤ line count. Problems capped at 12 + omission note. - Cross-coverage aggregation (`validateReviewCoverage`): failed items → `reviewer-failed` diagnostics; invalid-but-present → `invalid-result`; duplicate finding IDs across coverages → `duplicate-finding-id` diagnostic; any absent coverage → `missing-coverage`; ANY diagnostic ⇒ verdict blocked. Otherwise: applicable (direct/partial) high/blocker ⇒ fail; any applicable finding ⇒ pass_with_findings; else pass. Findings sorted severity then ID. Applicability not_triggered/explicitly_deferred findings never influence the verdict. - Fingerprint discipline: sha256 over project/sprint/target, sorted `path\0id\0hash` input lines, and sorted changed paths (fingerprintReviewManifest, review.go:1341). Determinism pinned across repeated preparations; smoke-harness project-index rows and roadmap `> Status:` lines are excluded from the hashed view while preserving line numbers so citations stay valid. - Persistence invariants: only schema+citation-valid results become completed checkpoints; late session events cannot regress terminal checkpoints or resurrect cleared sessions; failed/cancelled/blocked reviews preserve both the prior review.md bytes and the prior LastComplete (saveReviewState restores Verdict/Fingerprint/Digest from LastComplete on non-completed saves when present); completed save clears ProvisionalVerdict and Resume. - Restart discards coverage and sessions (all subsequent runtime calls carry no session identity — pinned). Resume continues validated coverage and retained sessions in a fresh process. Rebase across a changed fingerprint admits only previously VALIDATED completed results and emits an explicit diagnostic. - Sanitization: diagnostics pass through safeReviewText/safeError (secret redaction via config.RedactValue, NUL/CR/LF stripping, truncation ~180 chars, workspace-root path replacement). ## 6. Trust boundaries - Reviewer output is untrusted model data. Extraction tolerates prose-wrapped JSON (terminal output, reversed event scan, nested keys review_result/structured_output/output/content/text/message/part, per-object-boundary streaming decode accepting anything with a CoverageID), but acceptance requires the full decision table; extracted content never executes and reaches review.md only as rendered, validated text. - Citation containment: paths must match frozen manifest contents exactly (normalized from the snapshot read paths reviewers were told to cite); traversal-style citations like ../../etc/passwd or foreign files fail validation and block the verdict. - Prompt injection surface: governed inputs and changed target files are embedded verbatim into reviewer prompts; the framing labels them evidence, and reviewers hold no write capability (read-only sandbox, deny-default tool policy, unsupported-permission enforcement fails closed). - Changed-path scope originates in actor-editable execute evidence (.run-state.json); governed artifacts are filtered out, remaining paths are containment-checked against the approved target before their contents enter the manifest, and escapes become preflight findings. - Workspace overrides prompts/review.md / templates/review.md are user-controlled prompt prefixes (validated for required headings, placeholder-free) heading every reviewer request. - Snapshot path segments derive from the hex fingerprint (separator/NUL checked); snapshot reuse trusts only marker presence. - Publication and durable-operation acceptance delegate trust transitions to gitpublish and run-control (separate surfaces). ## 7. External effects and lifecycle semantics - Effects confined to workspace + local DBs + git publisher: atomic artifact replace, flow-state updates (including heartbeats during long fan-outs), runtime store creation/retention/deletion, metrics append, snapshot create/remove, publication commits, durable operation records, stderr progress. - Cancellation: ctx honored at prefix build, between runtime calls, in AgentWrap validators, and after collection drains; cancelled runs persist terminal state and keep prior artifacts. # Context Pack: `sprint-conformance-review` — Sprint review fan-out and verdict synthesis

Target: ultraplan-go @ 8eef70f4903b25580719960009a170945bdad9ad (frozen).
Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5.
Domain: governed-sprint-delivery. Risk: high. Descriptive only — no defect judgments.

## 1. Purpose

The product-owned post-execute conformance review (protocol name: Review Sprint Protocol; CLI alias `conformance-review`). This surface:

1. **Prepares a frozen review manifest** (`PrepareReview`, review.go:169): reads every governed sprint/project input plus execute evidence, resolves selected contracts and review protocols through project-index/sprint-index catalogs, hashes all inputs into a deterministic fingerprint, records changed target paths, and collects preflight validation findings instead of failing fast.
2. **Fans out bounded read-only reviewers** (`Review` → `runReviewer`): one structured agentwrap request per selected contract plus one independent handbook reviewer, worker pool bounded by configured concurrency (default `execution.default_parallel`, fallback 3, hard cap 16), each against a frozen filesystem snapshot of the inputs.
3. **Judges reviewer output by decision tables**: tolerant JSON extraction, then strict schema/citation/coverage/duplicate rules; the verdict ladder pass / pass_with_findings / fail / blocked is computed in product code, never by a model.
4. **Persists progress and results**: per-coverage checkpoints and retained session IDs live in flow-state.json (`ReviewStageState.Resume`), completed coverage snapshots in `ReviewStageState.LastComplete`, attempt lifecycle in ActiveAttempt/LastAttempt.
5. **Validates then atomically replaces** sprint-root `review.md`, publishes review.md + flow-state.json via gitpublish, and cleans up the snapshot and completed runtime sessions.

Downstream gates consume the recorded outcome: smoke's review gate, QA map, Verify's assessment, and status rendering.

308: 		data, readErr := os.ReadFile(full)
309: 		if readErr != nil {
310: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: prefix + "-" + slugReviewID(selected.Name), Kind: kind, Name: selected.Name, Path: path, Hash: "missing"})
311: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review manifest", selected.Name, path, "unreadable catalog entry", readErr.Error(), "Restore the selected catalog file."))
312: 			return
313: 		}
314: 		id := prefix + "-" + slugReviewID(selected.Name)
315: 		in := reviewInput(id, kind, selected.Name, path, string(data))
316: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, in)
317: 		if reviewer {
318: 			manifest.Coverage = append(manifest.Coverage, in)
319: 		}
320: 		manifest.Contents[path] = string(data)
321: 	}
322: 	for _, selected := range idx.Contracts {
323: 		resolve(selected, project.SectionActiveContractPool, "contract", "contract", true)
324: 	}
325: 	for _, selected := range idx.ReviewProtocols {
326: 		resolve(selected, project.SectionReviewProtocols, "protocol", "protocol", false)
327: 	}
328: 	if unresolvedExecutePlanTasks(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan)], manifest.Contents[runPath], planManifest) {
329: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Plan Execution", "tasks", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan), "plan tasks are not resolved", "one or more unchecked top-level tasks lack an explicit deferred run-state outcome", "Complete each executable task or defer it with an explicit rationale before review."))
330: 	}
331: 	// The handbook receives an independent reviewer even though it is also a governed input.
332: 	if handbook := findReviewInput(manifest.Inputs, "technical-handbook"); handbook.Path != "" {
333: 		handbook.ID, handbook.Kind, handbook.Name = "handbook", "handbook", "Technical Handbook"
334: 		manifest.Coverage = append(manifest.Coverage, handbook)
335: 	}
336: 	if strings.TrimSpace(manifest.Model) == "" || manifest.Model == "unresolved" {
337: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Configuration", "review model", "", "missing review model", "no review, plan, or runtime model is configured", "Set planning.review_model or planning.plan_model."))
338: 	}
339: 	for _, command := range reviewVerificationCommands(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan)]) {
340: 		if !strings.Contains(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageExecute)], command) {
341: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Verification Evidence", command, ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageExecute), "approved verification evidence missing", "execute.md does not record the planned command", "Run the approved command and record its result in execute.md."))
342: 		}
343: 	}
344: 	if run := manifest.Contents[runPath]; run != "" && reviewRunStateIncomplete([]byte(run)) {
345: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Plan Execution", "run-state", runPath, "execute is incomplete", "run state contains non-complete tasks or status", "Complete or safely resolve execute before review."))
346: 	}
347: 	if len(manifest.ChangedPaths) == 0 {
348: 		manifest.ChangedPaths = []string{"(execute evidence did not enumerate changed paths)"}
349: 	} else {
350: 		for _, changed := range manifest.ChangedPaths {
351: 			full := changed
352: 			if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
353: 				full = filepath.Join(manifest.Target, filepath.FromSlash(changed))
354: 			}
355: 			if !inside(manifest.Target, full) {
356: 				findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", changed, changed, "changed path escapes target", "path is outside the approved implementation target", "Use contained execute evidence."))
357: 				continue
358: 			}
359: 			data, readErr := os.ReadFile(full)
360: 			if readErr != nil {
361: 				findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", changed, changed, "changed target input unreadable", readErr.Error(), "Restore the changed path or correct execute evidence."))
362: 				continue
363: 			}
364: 			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(manifest.Target, full)
365: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("target-"+slugReviewID(rel), "target", rel, "target/"+filepath.ToSlash(rel), string(data)))
366: 			manifest.Contents["target/"+filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = string(data)
367: 		}
368: 	}
369: 	sort.Slice(manifest.Coverage, func(i, j int) bool { return manifest.Coverage[i].ID < manifest.Coverage[j].ID })
370: 	sort.Slice(manifest.Inputs, func(i, j int) bool { return manifest.Inputs[i].Path < manifest.Inputs[j].Path })
371: 	manifest.Fingerprint = fingerprintReviewManifest(manifest)
372: 	sortSprintFindings(findings)
373: 	return manifest, findings, nil
374: }

404: func (s Service) Review(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req ReviewRequest) (ReviewResult, error) {
405: 	m, findings, err := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, req)
406: 	result := ReviewResult{Project: m.Project, Sprint: m.Sprint, DryRun: req.DryRun, Fingerprint: m.Fingerprint, Artifact: reviewArtifact(m), Status: ReviewReady, Focused: append([]string(nil), req.Focus...)}
407: 	if err != nil {
408: 		return result, err
409: 	}
410: 	if !req.DryRun && !req.PromptOnly {
411: 		lockedCtx, release, lockErr := s.acquireMutationContext(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef)
412: 		if lockErr != nil {
413: 			return result, lockErr
414: 		}
415: 		defer release()
416: 		ctx = lockedCtx
417: 	}
418: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
419: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewBlocked, ReviewVerdictBlocked
420: 		for _, f := range findings {
421: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "preflight", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, f.Problem+": "+f.Cause)})
422: 		}
423: 		if !req.DryRun {
424: 			if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage)); saveErr != nil {
425: 				return result, errors.Join(fmt.Errorf("review prerequisites failed validation"), saveErr)
426: 			}
427: 		}
428: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("review prerequisites failed validation")
429: 	}
430: 	sp, inputs, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
431: 	if err != nil {
432: 		return result, err
433: 	}
434: 	m.SharedPrefix, err = s.prepareSharedPromptContext(ctx, sp, inputs, true)
435: 	if err != nil {
436: 		if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
437: 			result.Status = ReviewCancelled
438: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "cancelled", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, err.Error())})
439: 			if !req.DryRun && !req.PromptOnly {
440: 				return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage), err)
441: 			}
442: 		}
443: 		return result, err
444: 	}
445: 	result.Prompt, err = composeStagePromptChecked(m.SharedPrefix, renderReviewPreview(m))
446: 	if err != nil {
447: 		return result, err
448: 	}
449: 	if req.DryRun || req.PromptOnly {
450: 		result.Message = "review dry run"
451: 		return result, nil
452: 	}
453: 	if s.runtime == nil {
454: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("runtime is required for review")
455: 	}
456: 	if req.Restart && len(req.Focus) > 0 {
457: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("--restart cannot be combined with focused review")
458: 	}
459: 	result.Status = ReviewRunning
460: 	result.Restarted = req.Restart
461: 	if err := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage)); err != nil {
462: 		return result, err
463: 	}
464: 	runCoverage, coverage, focusErr := s.reviewCoveragePlan(projectRef, sprintRef, m, req.Focus)
465: 	if focusErr != nil {
466: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewBlocked, ReviewVerdictBlocked
467: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "focus", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, focusErr.Error())})
468: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage), focusErr)
469: 	}
470: 	resumeSessions := map[string]string{}
471: 	completed := 0
472: 	if len(req.Focus) == 0 {
473: 		resume, rebased, resumeErr := s.initializeReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef, m, req.Restart)
474: 		if resumeErr != nil {
475: 			result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewFailed, ReviewVerdictBlocked
476: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "resume-state", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, resumeErr.Error())})
477: 			return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage), resumeErr)
478: 		}
479: 		runCoverage, coverage, resumeSessions, completed = reviewResumePlan(s.root, m, resume)
480: 		result.Resumed = !req.Restart && (completed > 0 || len(resumeSessions) > 0)
481: 		result.Reused = completed
482: 		if rebased > 0 {
483: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "resume-rebased", Message: fmt.Sprintf("reused %d validated reviewer result(s) from the prior input fingerprint; incomplete coverage uses the current snapshot", rebased)})
484: 		}
485: 	}
486: 	reviewerRoot, snapshotErr := prepareReviewSnapshot(m)
487: 	if snapshotErr != nil {
488: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewFailed, ReviewVerdictBlocked
489: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "snapshot", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, snapshotErr.Error())})
490: 		if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage)); saveErr != nil {
491: 			return result, errors.Join(snapshotErr, saveErr)
492: 		}
493: 		return result, snapshotErr
494: 	}
495: 	m.ReviewerRoot = reviewerRoot
496: 	workers := m.Concurrency
497: 	if workers > len(runCoverage) {
498: 		workers = len(runCoverage)
499: 	}
500: 	if workers < 1 {
501: 		workers = 1
502: 	}
503: 	type item struct {
504: 		index     int
505: 		value     ReviewCoverageResult
506: 		sessionID string
507: 	}
508: 	type sessionItem struct {
509: 		coverageID string
510: 		sessionID  string
511: 	}
512: 	jobs := make(chan int)
513: 	done := make(chan item, len(runCoverage))
514: 	sessions := make(chan sessionItem, max(1, len(runCoverage)*4))
515: 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
516: 	for w := 0; w < workers; w++ {
517: 		wg.Add(1)
518: 		go func() {
519: 			defer wg.Done()
520: 			for i := range jobs {
521: 				c := runCoverage[i]
522: 				sessionID := resumeSessions[c.ID]
523: 				lastSessionID := sessionID
524: 				value, finalSessionID := s.runReviewer(ctx, m, c, sessionID, func(id string) {
525: 					if id != "" && id != lastSessionID {
526: 						lastSessionID = id
527: 						sessions <- sessionItem{coverageID: c.ID, sessionID: id}
528: 					}
529: 				})
530: 				done <- item{index: i, value: value, sessionID: finalSessionID}
531: 			}
532: 		}()
533: 	}
534: 	go func() {
535: 		for i := range runCoverage {
536: 			jobs <- i
537: 		}
538: 		close(jobs)
539: 		wg.Wait()
540: 		close(sessions)
541: 		close(done)
542: 	}()
543: 	var progressSaveErr error
544: 	completedSessionIDs := map[string]bool{}
545: 	for done != nil || sessions != nil {
546: 		select {
547: 		case session, ok := <-sessions:
548: 			if !ok {
549: 				sessions = nil
550: 				continue
551: 			}
552: 			if session.sessionID != "" && len(req.Focus) == 0 {
553: 				if saveErr := s.saveReviewResumeSession(projectRef, sprintRef, m.Fingerprint, session.coverageID, session.sessionID); saveErr != nil {
554: 					progressSaveErr = errors.Join(progressSaveErr, saveErr)
555: 				}
556: 			}
557: 		case got, ok := <-done:
558: 			if !ok {
559: 				done = nil
560: 				continue
561: 			}
562: 			if got.value.Error == "" && !reviewCoverageCheckpointValid(s.root, m, got.value) {
563: 				got.value.Error = "reviewer result failed schema or citation validation"
564: 			}
565: 			for i := range m.Coverage {
566: 				if m.Coverage[i].ID == got.value.CoverageID {
567: 					coverage[i] = got.value
568: 					break
569: 				}
570: 			}
571: 			completed++
572: 			if got.sessionID != "" {
573: 				completedSessionIDs[got.sessionID] = true
574: 			}
575: 			if req.Progress != nil {
576: 				req.Progress(ReviewProgress{Completed: completed, Total: len(coverage), CoverageID: got.value.CoverageID, Message: "reviewer complete"})
577: 			}
578: 			result.Coverage = coverage
579: 			if len(req.Focus) == 0 {
580: 				if saveErr := s.saveReviewResumeResult(projectRef, sprintRef, m.Fingerprint, got.value, got.sessionID); saveErr != nil {
581: 					progressSaveErr = errors.Join(progressSaveErr, saveErr)
582: 				}
583: 			}
584: 			if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage)); saveErr != nil {
585: 				progressSaveErr = errors.Join(progressSaveErr, saveErr)
586: 			}
587: 		}
588: 	}
589: 	result.Coverage = coverage
590: 	validatedFindings, validationDiagnostics, validatedVerdict := validateReviewCoverage(s.root, m, coverage)
591: 	result.Findings = validatedFindings
592: 	result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, validationDiagnostics...)
593: 	result.Verdict = validatedVerdict
594: 	if progressSaveErr != nil {
595: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewFailed, ReviewVerdictBlocked
596: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "state-write-failed", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, progressSaveErr.Error())})
597: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), progressSaveErr)
598: 	}
599: 	if ctx.Err() != nil {
600: 		result.Status = ReviewCancelled
601: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "cancelled", Message: ctx.Err().Error()})
602: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), ctx.Err())
603: 	}
604: 	if result.Verdict == ReviewVerdictBlocked {
605: 		result.Status = ReviewFailed
606: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), fmt.Errorf("review failed to produce complete valid coverage"))
607: 	}
608: 	current, currentFindings, currentErr := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, req)
609: 	if currentErr != nil || len(currentFindings) > 0 || current.Fingerprint != m.Fingerprint {
610: 		for _, message := range reviewManifestChanges(m, current, currentFindings, currentErr) {
611: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "inputs-changed", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, message)})
612: 		}
613: 	}
614: 	result.Status = ReviewCompleted
615: 	content := RenderReviewMarkdown(m, result)
616: 	if vf := ValidateReviewContent(content, m); len(vf) > 0 {
617: 		result.Status = ReviewFailed
618: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "artifact-invalid", Message: vf[0].Problem})
619: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), fmt.Errorf("generated review.md failed validation"))
620: 	}
621: 	path, _ := ArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageReview)
622: 	if err := atomicWriteReview(path, []byte(content)); err != nil {
623: 		result.Status = ReviewFailed
624: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "write-failed", Message: safeError(err)})
625: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), err)
626: 	}
627: 	now := s.now().UTC()
628: 	result.Message = "review complete"
629: 	result.Artifact = ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReview)
630: 	if err := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage)); err != nil {
631: 		return result, err
632: 	}
633: 	publications, publishErr := s.publishReviewStage(ctx, sp)
634: 	result.Publications = append(result.Publications, publications...)
635: 	if publishErr != nil {
636: 		return result, publishErr
637: 	}
638: 	_ = os.RemoveAll(reviewerRoot)
639: 	_ = now
640: 	if result.Verdict == ReviewFail {
641: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("review completed with failing verdict")
642: 	}
643: 	for sessionID := range completedSessionIDs {
644: 		_ = s.deleteCompletedSession(ctx, sessionID)
645: 	}
646: 	return result, nil
647: }

651: 		return result, errors.Join(cause, fmt.Errorf("persist terminal review state: %w", saveErr))
652: 	}
653: 	return result, cause

656: func (s Service) reviewCoveragePlan(projectRef, sprintRef string, m ReviewManifest, focus []string) ([]ReviewInput, []ReviewCoverageResult, error) {
657: 	coverage := make([]ReviewCoverageResult, len(m.Coverage))
658: 	if len(focus) == 0 {
659: 		return m.Coverage, coverage, nil
660: 	}
661: 	wanted := map[string]bool{}
662: 	for _, raw := range focus {
663: 		for _, id := range strings.Split(raw, ",") {
664: 			id = strings.TrimSpace(id)
665: 			if id != "" {
666: 				wanted[id] = true
667: 			}
668: 		}
669: 	}
670: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, Sprint{Project: m.Project, Slug: m.Sprint, Path: filepath.Join(s.root, filepath.FromSlash(m.SprintRoot))})
671: 	if err != nil || state.Review == nil || state.Review.LastComplete == nil {
672: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review requires a previous complete review with retained coverage")
673: 	}
674: 	previous := state.Review.LastComplete
675: 	if previous.InputFingerprint != m.Fingerprint {
676: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review cannot retain coverage from a different input fingerprint")
677: 	}
678: 	retained := map[string]ReviewCoverageResult{}
679: 	for _, item := range previous.Coverage {
680: 		retained[item.CoverageID] = item
681: 	}
682: 	var run []ReviewInput
683: 	for i, item := range m.Coverage {
684: 		if wanted[item.ID] {
685: 			run = append(run, item)
686: 			delete(wanted, item.ID)
687: 			continue
688: 		}
689: 		prior, ok := retained[item.ID]
690: 		if !ok || prior.Error != "" {
691: 			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review lacks valid retained coverage %q", item.ID)
692: 		}
693: 		coverage[i] = prior
694: 	}
695: 	if len(wanted) > 0 {
696: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review names unknown coverage")
697: 	}
698: 	if len(run) == 0 {
699: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review requires at least one coverage id")
700: 	}
701: 	return run, coverage, nil
702: }

704: func (s Service) initializeReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef string, m ReviewManifest, restart bool) (ReviewResumeState, int, error) {
705: 	sp, _, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
706: 	if err != nil {
707: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, err
708: 	}
709: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
710: 	if err != nil {
711: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, err
712: 	}
713: 	if state.Review == nil || state.Review.ActiveAttempt == nil {
714: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, fmt.Errorf("review attempt state is unavailable")
715: 	}
716: 	current := state.Review.Resume
717: 	rebased := 0
718: 	if restart || !reviewResumeCompatible(current, m) {
719: 		checkpoints := make([]ReviewCoverageCheckpoint, 0, len(m.Coverage))
720: 		now := s.now().UTC()
721: 		prior := map[string]ReviewCoverageCheckpoint{}
722: 		if !restart && reviewResumeShapeCompatible(current, m) {
723: 			for _, checkpoint := range current.Coverage {
724: 				prior[checkpoint.CoverageID] = checkpoint
725: 			}
726: 		}
727: 		for _, item := range m.Coverage {
728: 			checkpoint := ReviewCoverageCheckpoint{CoverageID: item.ID, Status: AttemptPending, UpdatedAt: now}
729: 			if previous, ok := prior[item.ID]; ok && previous.Status == AttemptCompleted && previous.Result != nil && reviewCoverageCheckpointValid(s.root, m, *previous.Result) {
730: 				checkpoint.Status = AttemptCompleted
731: 				checkpoint.Result = previous.Result
732: 				rebased++
733: 			}
734: 			checkpoints = append(checkpoints, checkpoint)
735: 		}
736: 		current = &ReviewResumeState{
737: 			AttemptID:        state.Review.ActiveAttempt.ID,
738: 			InputFingerprint: m.Fingerprint,
739: 			Model:            m.Model,
740: 			UpdatedAt:        now,
741: 			Coverage:         checkpoints,
742: 		}
743: 	} else {
744: 		current.AttemptID = state.Review.ActiveAttempt.ID
745: 		current.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
746: 	}
747: 	state.Review.Resume = current
748: 	if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, state); err != nil {
749: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, err
750: 	}
751: 	return *current, rebased, nil
752: }
753: 
754: func reviewResumeCompatible(state *ReviewResumeState, m ReviewManifest) bool {
755: 	return state != nil && state.InputFingerprint == m.Fingerprint && reviewResumeShapeCompatible(state, m)
756: }
757: 
758: func reviewResumeShapeCompatible(state *ReviewResumeState, m ReviewManifest) bool {
759: 	if state == nil || state.Model != m.Model || len(state.Coverage) != len(m.Coverage) {
760: 		return false
761: 	}
762: 	seen := map[string]bool{}
763: 	for _, item := range state.Coverage {
764: 		seen[item.CoverageID] = true
765: 	}
766: 	for _, item := range m.Coverage {
767: 		if !seen[item.ID] {
768: 			return false
769: 		}
770: 	}
771: 	return true
772: }

774: func reviewResumePlan(root string, m ReviewManifest, state ReviewResumeState) ([]ReviewInput, []ReviewCoverageResult, map[string]string, int) {
775: 	checkpoints := map[string]ReviewCoverageCheckpoint{}
776: 	for _, item := range state.Coverage {

169: func (s Service) PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef string, req ReviewRequest) (ReviewManifest, []ValidationFinding, error) {
170: 	sp, inputs, catalog, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
171: 	if err != nil {
172: 		return ReviewManifest{}, nil, err
173: 	}
174: 	manifest := ReviewManifest{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, SprintRoot: workspace.Rel(s.root, sp.Path), Target: "", WorkspaceRoot: s.root, Contents: map[string]string{}}
175: 	manifest.Concurrency = req.Concurrency
176: 	if manifest.Concurrency <= 0 {
177: 		manifest.Concurrency = s.reviewConcurrency
178: 	}
179: 	if manifest.Concurrency <= 0 {
180: 		manifest.Concurrency = 3
181: 	}
182: 	if manifest.Concurrency > 16 {
183: 		manifest.Concurrency = 16
184: 	}
185: 	selection := s.reviewModelSelection(req.ModelOverride)
186: 	manifest.Model, manifest.ModelSource = selection.Model, selection.Source
187: 	if rt, ok := s.verificationRuntime[VerificationPhaseConformanceReview]; ok {
188: 		manifest.Variant = rt.Variant
189: 	} else if rt, ok := s.stageRuntime[StagePlan]; ok {
190: 		manifest.Variant = rt.Variant
191: 	}
192: 	var findings []ValidationFinding
193: 	var assetErr error
194: 	manifest.PromptTemplate, assetErr = loadReviewAsset(s.root, "prompts/review.md", []string{"Automated Sprint Review"})
195: 	if assetErr != nil {
196: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Review assets", "prompts/review.md", "prompts/review.md", "invalid review prompt override", assetErr.Error(), "Remove or correct the intentional override."))
197: 	}
198: 	manifest.OutputTemplate, assetErr = loadReviewAsset(s.root, "templates/review.md", []string{"Review Context", "Final Assessment"})
199: 	if assetErr != nil {
200: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Review assets", "templates/review.md", "templates/review.md", "invalid review template override", assetErr.Error(), "Remove or correct the intentional override."))
201: 	}
202: 	if manifest.PromptTemplate != "" {
203: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("review-prompt", "asset", "review prompt", "prompts/review.md", manifest.PromptTemplate))
204: 		manifest.Contents["prompts/review.md"] = manifest.PromptTemplate
205: 	}
206: 	if manifest.OutputTemplate != "" {
207: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("review-template", "asset", "review template", "templates/review.md", manifest.OutputTemplate))
208: 		manifest.Contents["templates/review.md"] = manifest.OutputTemplate
209: 	}
210: 	idx, indexFindings := ValidateSprintIndexContent(inputs.SprintIndex, catalog)
211: 	findings = append(findings, indexFindings...)
212: 	target, targetFindings := s.resolveSprintTarget(sp, inputs.ProjectIndex, false)
213: 	findings = append(findings, targetFindings...)
214: 	manifest.Target = target.Path
215: 	base := []struct {
216: 		id, kind string
217: 		stage    PlanningStage
218: 	}{
219: 		{"requirements", "governed", StageRequirements}, {"code-context", "governed", StageCodeContext}, {"sprint-index", "governed", StageSprintIndex},
220: 		{"technical-handbook", "handbook", StageTechnicalHandbook}, {"reasoning", "governed", StageReasoning},
221: 		{"plan", "governed", StagePlan}, {"execute", "governed", StageExecute},
222: 	}
223: 	projectRoot := filepath.Join(s.root, "projects", sp.Project)
224: 	projectInputs := []struct{ id, path string }{{"project-index", filepath.Join(projectRoot, "project-index.md")}, {"roadmap", filepath.Join(projectRoot, "roadmap.md")}}
225: 	for _, doc := range inputs.Docs {
226: 		projectInputs = append(projectInputs, struct{ id, path string }{"doc-" + slugReviewID(doc), filepath.Join(projectRoot, filepath.FromSlash(doc))})
227: 	}
228: 	for _, item := range projectInputs {
229: 		rel := workspace.Rel(s.root, item.path)
230: 		data, readErr := os.ReadFile(item.path)
231: 		if readErr != nil {
232: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: item.id, Kind: "governed", Name: item.id, Path: rel, Hash: "missing"})
233: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review prerequisites", item.id, rel, "missing governed project input", safeError(readErr), "Restore the governed project input."))
234: 			continue
235: 		}
236: 		content := string(data)
237: 		if item.id == "project-index" {
238: 			content = reviewRelevantProjectIndexContent(content)
239: 		} else if item.id == "roadmap" {
240: 			content = reviewRelevantRoadmapContent(content)
241: 		}
242: 		manifest.Contents[rel] = content
243: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput(item.id, "governed", item.id, rel, content))
244: 	}
245: 	for _, item := range base {
246: 		data, readErr := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, item.stage)
247: 		path := ArtifactRelPath(sp, item.stage)
248: 		if readErr != nil || strings.TrimSpace(data) == "" {
249: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: item.id, Kind: item.kind, Name: item.id, Path: path, Hash: "missing"})
250: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review prerequisites", item.id, path, "missing review input", safeError(readErr), "Complete execute and all governed sprint artifacts before review."))
251: 			continue
252: 		}
253: 		manifest.Contents[path] = data
254: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput(item.id, item.kind, item.id, path, data))
255: 	}
256: 	areaDir, _ := ArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageAreaReasoning)
257: 	if entries, readErr := os.ReadDir(areaDir); readErr == nil {
258: 		for _, entry := range entries {
259: 			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(entry.Name()), ".md") {
260: 				continue
261: 			}
262: 			full := filepath.Join(areaDir, entry.Name())
263: 			data, fileErr := os.ReadFile(full)
264: 			rel := workspace.Rel(s.root, full)
265: 			if fileErr != nil {
266: 				manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: "area-" + slugReviewID(entry.Name()), Kind: "governed", Name: entry.Name(), Path: rel, Hash: "missing"})
267: 				findings = append(findings, finding("Review prerequisites", entry.Name(), rel, "missing area reasoning input", safeError(fileErr), "Restore selected area reasoning."))
268: 				continue
269: 			}
270: 			manifest.Contents[rel] = string(data)
271: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("area-"+slugReviewID(entry.Name()), "governed", entry.Name(), rel, string(data)))
272: 		}
273: 	}
274: 	planManifest, planFindings := s.planManifest(sp, inputs, catalog)
275: 	findings = append(findings, planFindings...)
276: 	if len(planFindings) == 0 {
277: 		findings = append(findings, ValidatePlanContent(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan)], planManifest)...)
278: 	}
279: 	runPath := ExecuteRunStateRelPath(sp)
280: 	if data, readErr := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(s.root, filepath.FromSlash(runPath))); readErr == nil {
281: 		manifest.Contents[runPath] = string(data)
282: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("run-state", "governed", "run-state", runPath, string(data)))
283: 		manifest.ChangedPaths = excludeGovernedReviewPaths(reviewChangedPaths(data), manifest.Inputs)
284: 	} else {
285: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: "run-state", Kind: "governed", Name: "run-state", Path: runPath, Hash: "missing"})
286: 	}
287: 	if target.Path != "" {
288: 		identity, identityErr := targetRevisionIdentity(target.Path)
289: 		if identityErr != nil {
290: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", "target identity", "target/.identity", "target identity unavailable", identityErr.Error(), "Restore a contained readable target tree."))
291: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: "target-identity", Kind: "target", Name: "target identity", Path: "target/.identity", Hash: "missing"})
292: 		} else {
293: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: "target-identity", Kind: "target", Name: "target identity", Path: "target/.identity", Hash: identity})
294: 		}
295: 	}
296: 	resolve := func(selected SelectedItem, section project.CatalogSection, kind, prefix string, reviewer bool) {
297: 		entry, ok := catalogEntry(catalog, section, selected)
298: 		if !ok {
299: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review manifest", selected.Name, selected.Path, "catalog entry unresolved", "selected entry is not uniquely resolvable", "Fix project-index.md or sprint-index.md."))
300: 			return
301: 		}
302: 		path := entry.Path
303: 		full, pathErr := workspace.ResolveInside(s.root, path)
304: 		if pathErr != nil {
305: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review manifest", selected.Name, path, "unsafe catalog path", pathErr.Error(), "Use a contained workspace path."))
306: 			return
307: 		}
308: 		data, readErr := os.ReadFile(full)
309: 		if readErr != nil {
310: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: prefix + "-" + slugReviewID(selected.Name), Kind: kind, Name: selected.Name, Path: path, Hash: "missing"})
311: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review manifest", selected.Name, path, "unreadable catalog entry", readErr.Error(), "Restore the selected catalog file."))
312: 			return
313: 		}
314: 		id := prefix + "-" + slugReviewID(selected.Name)
315: 		in := reviewInput(id, kind, selected.Name, path, string(data))
316: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, in)
317: 		if reviewer {
318: 			manifest.Coverage = append(manifest.Coverage, in)
319: 		}
320: 		manifest.Contents[path] = string(data)
321: 	}
322: 	for _, selected := range idx.Contracts {
323: 		resolve(selected, project.SectionActiveContractPool, "contract", "contract", true)
324: 	}
325: 	for _, selected := range idx.ReviewProtocols {
326: 		resolve(selected, project.SectionReviewProtocols, "protocol", "protocol", false)
327: 	}
328: 	if unresolvedExecutePlanTasks(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan)], manifest.Contents[runPath], planManifest) {
329: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Plan Execution", "tasks", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan), "plan tasks are not resolved", "one or more unchecked top-level tasks lack an explicit deferred run-state outcome", "Complete each executable task or defer it with an explicit rationale before review."))
330: 	}
331: 	// The handbook receives an independent reviewer even though it is also a governed input.
332: 	if handbook := findReviewInput(manifest.Inputs, "technical-handbook"); handbook.Path != "" {
333: 		handbook.ID, handbook.Kind, handbook.Name = "handbook", "handbook", "Technical Handbook"
334: 		manifest.Coverage = append(manifest.Coverage, handbook)
335: 	}
336: 	if strings.TrimSpace(manifest.Model) == "" || manifest.Model == "unresolved" {
337: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Configuration", "review model", "", "missing review model", "no review, plan, or runtime model is configured", "Set planning.review_model or planning.plan_model."))
338: 	}
339: 	for _, command := range reviewVerificationCommands(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan)]) {
340: 		if !strings.Contains(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageExecute)], command) {
341: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Verification Evidence", command, ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageExecute), "approved verification evidence missing", "execute.md does not record the planned command", "Run the approved command and record its result in execute.md."))
342: 		}
343: 	}
344: 	if run := manifest.Contents[runPath]; run != "" && reviewRunStateIncomplete([]byte(run)) {
345: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Plan Execution", "run-state", runPath, "execute is incomplete", "run state contains non-complete tasks or status", "Complete or safely resolve execute before review."))
346: 	}
347: 	if len(manifest.ChangedPaths) == 0 {
348: 		manifest.ChangedPaths = []string{"(execute evidence did not enumerate changed paths)"}
349: 	} else {
350: 		for _, changed := range manifest.ChangedPaths {
351: 			full := changed
352: 			if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
353: 				full = filepath.Join(manifest.Target, filepath.FromSlash(changed))
354: 			}
355: 			if !inside(manifest.Target, full) {
356: 				findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", changed, changed, "changed path escapes target", "path is outside the approved implementation target", "Use contained execute evidence."))
357: 				continue
358: 			}
359: 			data, readErr := os.ReadFile(full)
360: 			if readErr != nil {
361: 				findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", changed, changed, "changed target input unreadable", readErr.Error(), "Restore the changed path or correct execute evidence."))
362: 				continue
363: 			}
364: 			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(manifest.Target, full)
365: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("target-"+slugReviewID(rel), "target", rel, "target/"+filepath.ToSlash(rel), string(data)))
366: 			manifest.Contents["target/"+filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = string(data)
367: 		}
368: 	}
369: 	sort.Slice(manifest.Coverage, func(i, j int) bool { return manifest.Coverage[i].ID < manifest.Coverage[j].ID })
370: 	sort.Slice(manifest.Inputs, func(i, j int) bool { return manifest.Inputs[i].Path < manifest.Inputs[j].Path })
371: 	manifest.Fingerprint = fingerprintReviewManifest(manifest)
372: 	sortSprintFindings(findings)
373: 	return manifest, findings, nil
374: }

376: func (s Service) PromptReview(projectRef, sprintRef string, req ReviewRequest) (PromptPreview, error) {
377: 	m, findings, err := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, req)
378: 	if err != nil {
379: 		return PromptPreview{}, err
380: 	}
381: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
382: 		return PromptPreview{}, fmt.Errorf("review prerequisites failed validation")
383: 	}
384: 	sp, inputs, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
385: 	if err != nil {
386: 		return PromptPreview{}, err
387: 	}
388: 	m.SharedPrefix, err = s.prepareSharedPromptContext(context.Background(), sp, inputs, false)
389: 	if err != nil {
390: 		return PromptPreview{}, err
391: 	}
392: 	stagePrompt := renderReviewPreview(m)
393: 	if len(m.Coverage) > 0 {
394: 		stagePrompt = renderReviewerPrompt(m, m.Coverage[0])
395: 	}
396: 	prompt, err := composeStagePromptChecked(m.SharedPrefix, stagePrompt)
397: 	if err != nil {
398: 		return PromptPreview{}, err
399: 	}
400: 	explanation := explainComposedPrompt(prompt)
401: 	return PromptPreview{Project: m.Project, Sprint: m.Sprint, Prompt: prompt, Explanation: &explanation}, nil
402: }

404: func (s Service) Review(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req ReviewRequest) (ReviewResult, error) {
405: 	m, findings, err := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, req)
406: 	result := ReviewResult{Project: m.Project, Sprint: m.Sprint, DryRun: req.DryRun, Fingerprint: m.Fingerprint, Artifact: reviewArtifact(m), Status: ReviewReady, Focused: append([]string(nil), req.Focus...)}
407: 	if err != nil {
408: 		return result, err
409: 	}
410: 	if !req.DryRun && !req.PromptOnly {
411: 		lockedCtx, release, lockErr := s.acquireMutationContext(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef)
412: 		if lockErr != nil {
413: 			return result, lockErr
414: 		}
415: 		defer release()
416: 		ctx = lockedCtx
417: 	}
418: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
419: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewBlocked, ReviewVerdictBlocked
420: 		for _, f := range findings {
421: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "preflight", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, f.Problem+": "+f.Cause)})
422: 		}
423: 		if !req.DryRun {
424: 			if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage)); saveErr != nil {
425: 				return result, errors.Join(fmt.Errorf("review prerequisites failed validation"), saveErr)
426: 			}
427: 		}
428: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("review prerequisites failed validation")
429: 	}
430: 	sp, inputs, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
431: 	if err != nil {
432: 		return result, err
433: 	}
434: 	m.SharedPrefix, err = s.prepareSharedPromptContext(ctx, sp, inputs, true)
435: 	if err != nil {
436: 		if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
437: 			result.Status = ReviewCancelled
438: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "cancelled", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, err.Error())})
439: 			if !req.DryRun && !req.PromptOnly {
440: 				return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage), err)
441: 			}
442: 		}
443: 		return result, err
444: 	}
445: 	result.Prompt, err = composeStagePromptChecked(m.SharedPrefix, renderReviewPreview(m))
446: 	if err != nil {
447: 		return result, err
448: 	}
449: 	if req.DryRun || req.PromptOnly {
450: 		result.Message = "review dry run"
451: 		return result, nil
452: 	}
453: 	if s.runtime == nil {
454: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("runtime is required for review")
455: 	}
456: 	if req.Restart && len(req.Focus) > 0 {
457: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("--restart cannot be combined with focused review")
458: 	}
459: 	result.Status = ReviewRunning
460: 	result.Restarted = req.Restart
461: 	if err := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage)); err != nil {
462: 		return result, err
463: 	}
464: 	runCoverage, coverage, focusErr := s.reviewCoveragePlan(projectRef, sprintRef, m, req.Focus)
465: 	if focusErr != nil {
466: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewBlocked, ReviewVerdictBlocked
467: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "focus", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, focusErr.Error())})
468: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage), focusErr)
469: 	}
470: 	resumeSessions := map[string]string{}
471: 	completed := 0
472: 	if len(req.Focus) == 0 {
473: 		resume, rebased, resumeErr := s.initializeReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef, m, req.Restart)
474: 		if resumeErr != nil {
475: 			result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewFailed, ReviewVerdictBlocked
476: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "resume-state", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, resumeErr.Error())})
477: 			return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage), resumeErr)
478: 		}
479: 		runCoverage, coverage, resumeSessions, completed = reviewResumePlan(s.root, m, resume)
480: 		result.Resumed = !req.Restart && (completed > 0 || len(resumeSessions) > 0)
481: 		result.Reused = completed
482: 		if rebased > 0 {
483: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "resume-rebased", Message: fmt.Sprintf("reused %d validated reviewer result(s) from the prior input fingerprint; incomplete coverage uses the current snapshot", rebased)})
484: 		}
485: 	}
486: 	reviewerRoot, snapshotErr := prepareReviewSnapshot(m)
487: 	if snapshotErr != nil {
488: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewFailed, ReviewVerdictBlocked
489: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "snapshot", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, snapshotErr.Error())})
490: 		if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage)); saveErr != nil {
491: 			return result, errors.Join(snapshotErr, saveErr)
492: 		}
493: 		return result, snapshotErr
494: 	}
495: 	m.ReviewerRoot = reviewerRoot
496: 	workers := m.Concurrency
497: 	if workers > len(runCoverage) {
498: 		workers = len(runCoverage)
499: 	}
500: 	if workers < 1 {
501: 		workers = 1
502: 	}
503: 	type item struct {
504: 		index     int
505: 		value     ReviewCoverageResult
506: 		sessionID string
507: 	}
508: 	type sessionItem struct {
509: 		coverageID string
510: 		sessionID  string
511: 	}
512: 	jobs := make(chan int)
513: 	done := make(chan item, len(runCoverage))
514: 	sessions := make(chan sessionItem, max(1, len(runCoverage)*4))
515: 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
516: 	for w := 0; w < workers; w++ {
517: 		wg.Add(1)
518: 		go func() {
519: 			defer wg.Done()
520: 			for i := range jobs {
521: 				c := runCoverage[i]
522: 				sessionID := resumeSessions[c.ID]
523: 				lastSessionID := sessionID
524: 				value, finalSessionID := s.runReviewer(ctx, m, c, sessionID, func(id string) {
525: 					if id != "" && id != lastSessionID {
526: 						lastSessionID = id
527: 						sessions <- sessionItem{coverageID: c.ID, sessionID: id}
528: 					}
529: 				})
530: 				done <- item{index: i, value: value, sessionID: finalSessionID}
531: 			}
532: 		}()
533: 	}
534: 	go func() {
535: 		for i := range runCoverage {
536: 			jobs <- i
537: 		}
538: 		close(jobs)
539: 		wg.Wait()
540: 		close(sessions)
541: 		close(done)
542: 	}()
543: 	var progressSaveErr error
544: 	completedSessionIDs := map[string]bool{}
545: 	for done != nil || sessions != nil {
546: 		select {
547: 		case session, ok := <-sessions:
548: 			if !ok {
549: 				sessions = nil
550: 				continue
551: 			}
552: 			if session.sessionID != "" && len(req.Focus) == 0 {
553: 				if saveErr := s.saveReviewResumeSession(projectRef, sprintRef, m.Fingerprint, session.coverageID, session.sessionID); saveErr != nil {
554: 					progressSaveErr = errors.Join(progressSaveErr, saveErr)
555: 				}
556: 			}
557: 		case got, ok := <-done:
558: 			if !ok {
559: 				done = nil
560: 				continue
561: 			}
562: 			if got.value.Error == "" && !reviewCoverageCheckpointValid(s.root, m, got.value) {
563: 				got.value.Error = "reviewer result failed schema or citation validation"
564: 			}
565: 			for i := range m.Coverage {
566: 				if m.Coverage[i].ID == got.value.CoverageID {
567: 					coverage[i] = got.value
568: 					break
569: 				}
570: 			}
571: 			completed++
572: 			if got.sessionID != "" {
573: 				completedSessionIDs[got.sessionID] = true
574: 			}
575: 			if req.Progress != nil {
576: 				req.Progress(ReviewProgress{Completed: completed, Total: len(coverage), CoverageID: got.value.CoverageID, Message: "reviewer complete"})
577: 			}
578: 			result.Coverage = coverage
579: 			if len(req.Focus) == 0 {
580: 				if saveErr := s.saveReviewResumeResult(projectRef, sprintRef, m.Fingerprint, got.value, got.sessionID); saveErr != nil {
581: 					progressSaveErr = errors.Join(progressSaveErr, saveErr)
582: 				}
583: 			}
584: 			if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage)); saveErr != nil {
585: 				progressSaveErr = errors.Join(progressSaveErr, saveErr)
586: 			}
587: 		}
588: 	}
589: 	result.Coverage = coverage
590: 	validatedFindings, validationDiagnostics, validatedVerdict := validateReviewCoverage(s.root, m, coverage)
591: 	result.Findings = validatedFindings
592: 	result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, validationDiagnostics...)
593: 	result.Verdict = validatedVerdict
594: 	if progressSaveErr != nil {
595: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewFailed, ReviewVerdictBlocked
596: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "state-write-failed", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, progressSaveErr.Error())})
597: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), progressSaveErr)
598: 	}
599: 	if ctx.Err() != nil {
600: 		result.Status = ReviewCancelled
601: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "cancelled", Message: ctx.Err().Error()})
602: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), ctx.Err())
603: 	}
604: 	if result.Verdict == ReviewVerdictBlocked {
605: 		result.Status = ReviewFailed
606: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), fmt.Errorf("review failed to produce complete valid coverage"))
607: 	}
608: 	current, currentFindings, currentErr := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, req)
609: 	if currentErr != nil || len(currentFindings) > 0 || current.Fingerprint != m.Fingerprint {
610: 		for _, message := range reviewManifestChanges(m, current, currentFindings, currentErr) {
611: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "inputs-changed", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, message)})
612: 		}
613: 	}
614: 	result.Status = ReviewCompleted
615: 	content := RenderReviewMarkdown(m, result)
616: 	if vf := ValidateReviewContent(content, m); len(vf) > 0 {
617: 		result.Status = ReviewFailed
618: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "artifact-invalid", Message: vf[0].Problem})
619: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), fmt.Errorf("generated review.md failed validation"))
620: 	}
621: 	path, _ := ArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageReview)
622: 	if err := atomicWriteReview(path, []byte(content)); err != nil {
623: 		result.Status = ReviewFailed
624: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "write-failed", Message: safeError(err)})
625: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), err)
626: 	}
627: 	now := s.now().UTC()
628: 	result.Message = "review complete"
629: 	result.Artifact = ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReview)
630: 	if err := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage)); err != nil {
631: 		return result, err
632: 	}
633: 	publications, publishErr := s.publishReviewStage(ctx, sp)
634: 	result.Publications = append(result.Publications, publications...)
635: 	if publishErr != nil {
636: 		return result, publishErr
637: 	}
638: 	_ = os.RemoveAll(reviewerRoot)
639: 	_ = now
640: 	if result.Verdict == ReviewFail {
641: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("review completed with failing verdict")
642: 	}
643: 	for sessionID := range completedSessionIDs {
644: 		_ = s.deleteCompletedSession(ctx, sessionID)
645: 	}
646: 	return result, nil
647: }

649: func (s Service) persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef string, result ReviewResult, completed, total int, cause error) (ReviewResult, error) {
650: 	if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, total); saveErr != nil {
651: 		return result, errors.Join(cause, fmt.Errorf("persist terminal review state: %w", saveErr))
652: 	}
653: 	return result, cause
654: }

656: func (s Service) reviewCoveragePlan(projectRef, sprintRef string, m ReviewManifest, focus []string) ([]ReviewInput, []ReviewCoverageResult, error) {
657: 	coverage := make([]ReviewCoverageResult, len(m.Coverage))
658: 	if len(focus) == 0 {
659: 		return m.Coverage, coverage, nil
660: 	}
661: 	wanted := map[string]bool{}
662: 	for _, raw := range focus {
663: 		for _, id := range strings.Split(raw, ",") {
664: 			id = strings.TrimSpace(id)
665: 			if id != "" {
666: 				wanted[id] = true
667: 			}
668: 		}
669: 	}
670: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, Sprint{Project: m.Project, Slug: m.Sprint, Path: filepath.Join(s.root, filepath.FromSlash(m.SprintRoot))})
671: 	if err != nil || state.Review == nil || state.Review.LastComplete == nil {
672: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review requires a previous complete review with retained coverage")
673: 	}
674: 	previous := state.Review.LastComplete
675: 	if previous.InputFingerprint != m.Fingerprint {
676: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review cannot retain coverage from a different input fingerprint")
677: 	}
678: 	retained := map[string]ReviewCoverageResult{}
679: 	for _, item := range previous.Coverage {
680: 		retained[item.CoverageID] = item
681: 	}
682: 	var run []ReviewInput
683: 	for i, item := range m.Coverage {
684: 		if wanted[item.ID] {
685: 			run = append(run, item)
686: 			delete(wanted, item.ID)
687: 			continue
688: 		}
689: 		prior, ok := retained[item.ID]
690: 		if !ok || prior.Error != "" {
691: 			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review lacks valid retained coverage %q", item.ID)
692: 		}
693: 		coverage[i] = prior
694: 	}
695: 	if len(wanted) > 0 {
696: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review names unknown coverage")
697: 	}
698: 	if len(run) == 0 {
699: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review requires at least one coverage id")
700: 	}
701: 	return run, coverage, nil
702: }

704: func (s Service) initializeReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef string, m ReviewManifest, restart bool) (ReviewResumeState, int, error) {
705: 	sp, _, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
706: 	if err != nil {
707: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, err
708: 	}
709: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
710: 	if err != nil {
711: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, err
712: 	}
713: 	if state.Review == nil || state.Review.ActiveAttempt == nil {
714: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, fmt.Errorf("review attempt state is unavailable")
715: 	}
716: 	current := state.Review.Resume
717: 	rebased := 0
718: 	if restart || !reviewResumeCompatible(current, m) {
719: 		checkpoints := make([]ReviewCoverageCheckpoint, 0, len(m.Coverage))
720: 		now := s.now().UTC()
721: 		prior := map[string]ReviewCoverageCheckpoint{}
722: 		if !restart && reviewResumeShapeCompatible(current, m) {
723: 			for _, checkpoint := range current.Coverage {
724: 				prior[checkpoint.CoverageID] = checkpoint
725: 			}
726: 		}
727: 		for _, item := range m.Coverage {
728: 			checkpoint := ReviewCoverageCheckpoint{CoverageID: item.ID, Status: AttemptPending, UpdatedAt: now}
729: 			if previous, ok := prior[item.ID]; ok && previous.Status == AttemptCompleted && previous.Result != nil && reviewCoverageCheckpointValid(s.root, m, *previous.Result) {
730: 				checkpoint.Status = AttemptCompleted
731: 				checkpoint.Result = previous.Result
732: 				rebased++
733: 			}
734: 			checkpoints = append(checkpoints, checkpoint)
735: 		}
736: 		current = &ReviewResumeState{
737: 			AttemptID:        state.Review.ActiveAttempt.ID,
738: 			InputFingerprint: m.Fingerprint,
739: 			Model:            m.Model,
740: 			UpdatedAt:        now,
741: 			Coverage:         checkpoints,
742: 		}
743: 	} else {
744: 		current.AttemptID = state.Review.ActiveAttempt.ID
745: 		current.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
746: 	}
747: 	state.Review.Resume = current
748: 	if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, state); err != nil {
749: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, err
750: 	}
751: 	return *current, rebased, nil
752: }
753: 
754: func reviewResumeCompatible(state *ReviewResumeState, m ReviewManifest) bool {
755: 	return state != nil && state.InputFingerprint == m.Fingerprint && reviewResumeShapeCompatible(state, m)
756: }
757: 
758: func reviewResumeShapeCompatible(state *ReviewResumeState, m ReviewManifest) bool {
759: 	if state == nil || state.Model != m.Model || len(state.Coverage) != len(m.Coverage) {
760: 		return false
761: 	}
762: 	seen := map[string]bool{}
763: 	for _, item := range state.Coverage {
764: 		seen[item.CoverageID] = true
765: 	}
766: 	for _, item := range m.Coverage {
767: 		if !seen[item.ID] {
768: 			return false
769: 		}
770: 	}
771: 	return true
772: }

774: func reviewResumePlan(root string, m ReviewManifest, state ReviewResumeState) ([]ReviewInput, []ReviewCoverageResult, map[string]string, int) {
775: 	checkpoints := map[string]ReviewCoverageCheckpoint{}
776: 	for _, item := range state.Coverage {
777: 		checkpoints[item.CoverageID] = item
778: 	}
779: 	coverage := make([]ReviewCoverageResult, len(m.Coverage))
780: 	sessions := map[string]string{}
781: 	run := make([]ReviewInput, 0, len(m.Coverage))
782: 	completed := 0
783: 	for i, item := range m.Coverage {
784: 		checkpoint := checkpoints[item.ID]
785: 		if checkpoint.Status == AttemptCompleted && checkpoint.Result != nil && reviewCoverageCheckpointValid(root, m, *checkpoint.Result) {
786: 			coverage[i] = *checkpoint.Result
787: 			completed++
788: 			continue
789: 		}
790: 		if checkpoint.SessionID != "" && state.InputFingerprint == m.Fingerprint {
791: 			sessions[item.ID] = checkpoint.SessionID
792: 		}
793: 		run = append(run, item)
794: 	}
795: 	return run, coverage, sessions, completed
796: }
797: 
798: func reviewCoverageCheckpointValid(root string, m ReviewManifest, result ReviewCoverageResult) bool {
799: 	if result.Error != "" {
800: 		return false
801: 	}
802: 	single := m
803: 	single.Coverage = []ReviewInput{{ID: result.CoverageID}}
804: 	_, diagnostics, _ := validateReviewCoverage(root, single, []ReviewCoverageResult{result})
805: 	return len(diagnostics) == 0
806: }

808: func (s Service) saveReviewResumeSession(projectRef, sprintRef, fingerprint, coverageID, sessionID string) error {
809: 	return s.updateReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef, fingerprint, coverageID, func(checkpoint *ReviewCoverageCheckpoint, now time.Time) {
810: 		// Session events and completed results arrive on separate channels. A
811: 		// buffered session event may therefore be persisted after the terminal
812: 		// result; never let that late event restore a cleared session or regress a
813: 		// terminal checkpoint to running.
814: 		if checkpoint.Status == AttemptCompleted || checkpoint.Status == AttemptFailed {
815: 			return
816: 		}
817: 		checkpoint.SessionID = sessionID
818: 		checkpoint.Status = AttemptRunning
819: 		checkpoint.UpdatedAt = now
820: 	})
821: }
822: 
823: func (s Service) saveReviewResumeResult(projectRef, sprintRef, fingerprint string, result ReviewCoverageResult, sessionID string) error {
824: 	return s.updateReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef, fingerprint, result.CoverageID, func(checkpoint *ReviewCoverageCheckpoint, now time.Time) {
825: 		checkpoint.UpdatedAt = now
826: 		if result.Error == "" {
827: 			checkpoint.SessionID = ""
828: 			checkpoint.Status = AttemptCompleted
829: 			copy := result
830: 			checkpoint.Result = &copy
831: 		} else {
832: 			checkpoint.SessionID = sessionID
833: 			checkpoint.Status = AttemptFailed
834: 			checkpoint.Result = nil
835: 		}
836: 	})
837: }

839: func (s Service) updateReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef, fingerprint, coverageID string, update func(*ReviewCoverageCheckpoint, time.Time)) error {
840: 	sp, _, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
841: 	if err != nil {
842: 		return err
843: 	}
844: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
845: 	if err != nil {
846: 		return err
847: 	}
848: 	if state.Review == nil || state.Review.Resume == nil || state.Review.Resume.InputFingerprint != fingerprint {
849: 		return fmt.Errorf("review resume checkpoint no longer matches active inputs")
850: 	}
851: 	now := s.now().UTC()
852: 	if state.Review.ActiveAttempt != nil {
853: 		state.Review.ActiveAttempt.HeartbeatAt = now
854: 		state.Review.ActiveAttempt.OwnerPID = os.Getpid()
855: 	}
856: 	for i := range state.Review.Resume.Coverage {
857: 		if state.Review.Resume.Coverage[i].CoverageID == coverageID {
858: 			update(&state.Review.Resume.Coverage[i], now)
859: 			state.Review.Resume.UpdatedAt = now
860: 			return SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, state)
861: 		}
862: 	}
863: 	return fmt.Errorf("review resume checkpoint missing coverage %q", coverageID)
864: }

866: func (s Service) ValidateReview(projectRef, sprintRef string) (ValidationResult, error) {
867: 	m, findings, err := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, ReviewRequest{})
868: 	if err != nil {
869: 		return ValidationResult{}, err
870: 	}
871: 	sp, _, _, _ := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
872: 	path := ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReview)
873: 	if len(findings) == 0 {
874: 		data, readErr := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageReview)
875: 		if readErr != nil {
876: 			findings = append(findings, finding("review.md", "", path, "missing review", readErr.Error(), "Run the review stage."))
877: 		} else {
878: 			findings = append(findings, ValidateReviewContent(data, m)...)
879: 		}
880: 	}
881: 	return ValidationResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, Artifact: path, Findings: findings}, nil
882: }

884: func (s Service) runReviewer(ctx context.Context, m ReviewManifest, c ReviewInput, resumeSession string, onSession func(string)) (out ReviewCoverageResult, sessionID string) {
885: 	out.CoverageID = c.ID
886: 	defer func() {
887: 		if r := recover(); r != nil {
888: 			out.Error = fmt.Sprintf("reviewer panic: %v", r)
889: 		}
890: 	}()
891: 	stagePrompt := renderReviewerPrompt(m, c)
892: 	if resumeSession != "" {
893: 		stagePrompt = "Resume the interrupted review using the refreshed frozen snapshot paths in this request. " + stagePrompt
894: 	}
895: 	prompt, composeErr := composeStagePromptChecked(m.SharedPrefix, stagePrompt)
896: 	if composeErr != nil {
897: 		out.Error = safeReviewText(s.root, composeErr.Error())
898: 		return
899: 	}
900: 	req := s.runtimeRequest(prompt, map[string]string{"project": m.Project, "sprint": m.Sprint, "stage": string(StageReview), "coverage": c.ID, "model_source": m.ModelSource})
901: 	req.WorkDir = m.ReviewerRoot
902: 	req.Model = strings.TrimPrefix(m.Model, req.Provider+"/")
903: 	req.Sandbox = "read_only"
904: 	req.Permissions = "restricted"
905: 	req.RequireCaps = appendUnique(req.RequireCaps, "permissions")
906: 	req.Policy = pruntime.PermissionPolicy{Default: "deny", Tools: map[string]string{"read": "allow", "list": "allow", "search": "allow"}}
907: 	captured := &reviewOutputCapture{}
908: 	req.Validation = s.reviewValidationSpec(m, c, captured)
909: 	if resumeSession != "" {
910: 		req.SessionID, req.SessionAction = resumeSession, "continue"
911: 	}
912: 	previousOnEvent := req.OnEvent
913: 	req.OnEvent = func(event pruntime.Event) {
914: 		captured.observe(event.Payload)
915: 		if previousOnEvent != nil {
916: 			previousOnEvent(event)
917: 		}
918: 		if event.SessionID != "" {
919: 			if onSession != nil {
920: 				onSession(event.SessionID)
921: 			}
922: 		}
923: 	}
924: 	sp := Sprint{Project: m.Project, Slug: m.Sprint, Path: filepath.Join(s.root, "projects", m.Project, "sprints", m.Sprint)}
925: 	r, err := s.startSprintRuntime(ctx, sp, StageReview, req)
926: 	sessionID = r.SessionID
927: 	if sessionID != "" && onSession != nil {
928: 		onSession(sessionID)
929: 	}
930: 	if r.Permissions.UnsupportedCount > 0 {
931: 		out.Error = "runtime could not enforce review permission policy"
932: 		return
933: 	}
934: 	if ctx.Err() != nil {
935: 		out.Error = safeReviewText(s.root, ctx.Err().Error())
936: 		return
937: 	}
938: 	candidate, problems := extractValidatedReviewResult(s.root, m, c.ID, r)
939: 	if err == nil && len(problems) == 0 {
940: 		return candidate, sessionID
941: 	}
942: 	// The production AgentWrap stack already performed its bounded repairs.
943: 	// Runtime implementations without that wrapper retain a small equivalent
944: 	// fallback here so the product boundary remains deterministic in tests and
945: 	// alternate adapters.
946: 	if r.Validation.Configured {
947: 		if len(problems) == 0 && !r.Validation.Passed && len(r.Validation.Details) > 0 {
948: 			problems = append(problems, r.Validation.Details...)
949: 		}
950: 		if len(problems) > 0 {
951: 			out.Error = safeReviewText(s.root, strings.Join(problems, "; "))
952: 		} else if err != nil {
953: 			out.Error = safeReviewText(s.root, err.Error())
954: 		}
955: 		return
956: 	}
957: 	if len(problems) == 0 && err != nil {
958: 		problems = []string{safeReviewText(s.root, err.Error())}
959: 	}
960: 	for attempt := 1; attempt <= 2; attempt++ {
961: 		repair := req
962: 		repair.Validation = nil
963: 		repair.Prompt, composeErr = composeStagePromptChecked(m.SharedPrefix, buildReviewRepairPrompt(m, c, problems, r.TerminalOutput))
964: 		if composeErr != nil {
965: 			out.Error = safeReviewText(s.root, composeErr.Error())
966: 			return
967: 		}
968: 		if attempt == 1 && sessionID != "" {
969: 			repair.SessionID, repair.SessionAction = sessionID, "continue"
970: 		} else {
971: 			repair.SessionID, repair.SessionAction = "", "fresh"
972: 		}
973: 		repaired, repairErr := s.startSprintRuntime(ctx, sp, StageReview, repair)
974: 		if repaired.SessionID != "" {
975: 			sessionID = repaired.SessionID
976: 			if onSession != nil {
977: 				onSession(sessionID)
978: 			}
979: 		}
980: 		if repaired.Permissions.UnsupportedCount > 0 {
981: 			out.Error = "runtime could not enforce review permission policy during repair"
982: 			return
983: 		}
984: 		if ctx.Err() != nil {
985: 			out.Error = safeReviewText(s.root, ctx.Err().Error())
986: 			return
987: 		}
988: 		candidate, problems = extractValidatedReviewResult(s.root, m, c.ID, repaired)
989: 		if repairErr == nil && len(problems) == 0 {
990: 			return candidate, sessionID
991: 		}
992: 		if len(problems) == 0 && repairErr != nil {
993: 			problems = []string{safeReviewText(s.root, repairErr.Error())}
994: 		}
995: 	}
996: 	out.Error = safeReviewText(s.root, "structured review result remained invalid after bounded repair: "+strings.Join(problems, "; "))
997: 	return
998: }

1000: func validateReviewCoverage(root string, m ReviewManifest, results []ReviewCoverageResult) ([]ReviewFinding, []ReviewDiagnostic, ReviewVerdict) {
1001: 	var findings []ReviewFinding

250: func reviewManifestChanges(before, after ReviewManifest, findings []ValidationFinding, prepareErr error) []string {
